name: MediaMarkt
verdict: MediaMarkt is a brand of Media-Saturn-Holding, the retail group of listed Ceconomy AG (Frankfurt Stock Exchange, SDAX). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Listed German retail group, broad free float; JD.com agreed in July 2025 to acquire Ceconomy (about 2.2 billion euros), deal not closed at kit launch. No state or fund ownership in the chain. Feyenoord's front-of-shirt partner to mid-2030.
